benchmark.eligibility: first who-question in each hashed conversation with a single 2-4-word title-case alphabetic response; no gold fields consulted

corpus.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL per Wikimedia dataset card; article URLs provide attribution
corpus.inclusion_rule: all nonempty title/text rows from the complete pinned Parquet shard; no case/topic/entity selection

retrieval.engine: SQLite FTS5 BM25, disk backed, unicode61 tokenizer
retrieval.query_tokenizer: Unicode word regex with fixed English function-word removal

ground_truth: current question + prior context; following question continuity separate; no gold fields in retrieval queries
review_status: single-reviewer provisional until blinded independent review
